6.description: [Pending Restart] [Serpentshrine Caverns] [The Lurker Below] Corrected an issue where the width of Spout was to large.

[Pending Restart] [Temple of Ahn'Qiraji] [Lord Kri] Increased bounding radius of Lord Kri by 5 yards to cover two deeper alcove arms at the edges of his room. Player standing inside these alcoves should no longer gain the coward debuff.
[Pending Restart] [Ruins of Ahn'Qiraji] [The Prophet Skeram] Reduced the number of Psychic Chock casts.
[Pending Restart] [Ruins of Ahn'Qiraji] [Ossirian the Unscarred] Ossirian will now select the first Obelisc by proximity, selecting the closest he can find.
[Pending Restart] [Temple of Ahn'Qiraji] [C'thun] Corrected an issue where Giant Eye and Giant Claw tentacle would not split up into two and cut their health in half starting from 17-18 player.

[Pending Restart] [Temple of Ahn'Qiraji] [Ouro and Aera] Spawn of Ouro will now randomize their threat table after emerge, preventing them to imediatly focus whatever healer prest the buttons hardest while they were tunneling.

7.description: Frostfall now triggers Fingers of Frost, if known, when the effect ends.
Shadowfall now triggers Nightfall, if known, when the effect ends.
Firefall now triggers Hot Streak, if known, when the effect ends.
Forbidden Technique now has a 25 yard range, changed from 30.
Fleeting Shadows now triggers a new buff that allows Ambush to be used without stealth, instead of triggering Shadow Dance.

New Mystic Enchant: Whirling Bladestorm - You move 30% faster while using Bladestorm. Any player hit by Bladestorm will be knocked up in the air for a short time. The same player can only be affected once by this.

New Mystic Enchant: Grasping Roots - Transforms Mass Entanglement into Grasping Roots. Launches Grasping Roots forward from your position, traveling up to 10 yards, dealing Nature damage and rooting enemies for 3 sec that it passes through. The roots then retract to their original position bringing enemies affected by the root back with it. Usable while shapeshifted.
New Mystic Enchant: Deadly Leap - Heroic Leap deals 30% (15% versus players) extra damage to targets below 25% health. Killing an enemy with Heroic Leap resets its cooldown.
Fixed an issue where the Sweeping Strikes damage would also hit the target it was triggered from.

Added to tooltip that Ignite does not break the disorient of Chaos Meteor.
You now deal 10% less damage in PvP while Righteous Fury is active.
Pyroblast used with Presence of Mind now deals 20% reduced damage to players, changed from 15% overall reduced damage.
Heroic Leap is now usable while shapeshifted.
Ice Barrier now absorbs for 15% less.
